Privacy Policy (v1.0, 2026-08-12)

Control and storage: No online account is required. Ledgers, attachments, settings, and operation records stay on this device by default and are protected with SQLCipher, Android Keystore, and authenticated encryption. Vault card numbers and security codes use a separate key hierarchy and authentication for every sensitive action.

Network and third parties: Offline recording does not depend on a network. The app connects only when you explicitly use map styles, an exchange-rate service that receives only a currency pair and date, encrypted Google Drive backup within the drive.file scope, or a diagnostics endpoint to which you separately consent. The app has no ads, does not sell data, and never sends amounts, accounts, cards, notes, merchants, places, attachments, or backup contents.

Diagnostics: Feature telemetry and crash reporting are separate and off by default. Nothing is collected or sent before policy consent. If enabled, only fixed enums and fixed allowlisted fields are eligible. The installation ID rotates every 30 days; feature events are retained for at most 90 days and crash reports for at most 180 days. You can inspect or delete local queues. Disabling either option deletes its queue and installation identifier.

Permissions and output: Notification, document-directory, location, biometric, and Drive access are requested only for the related feature. Ordinary exports never contain a full card number, security code, or Vault field, and coordinates are off by default. Backups are always encrypted. User-controlled external exports and Drive backups are not deleted by Clear this device; cloud deletion has a separate reauthentication flow.

Your controls: Settings let you withdraw diagnostics consent, clear device data, separately delete cloud backups, or uninstall the app. A recovery password cannot be recovered and there is no application or server bypass. About lists the current version, source code, and open-source licenses. The publisher supplies the official policy URL and support contact in the store listing for the production release.
